series.summary: Hakari breaks down in tears and tells Rentarou she cannot go on, right as her mother Hahari appears. Hahari has been quietly worrying for a long time and gently delivers her verdict on the relationship, while Hakari's small denial shows the first crack.

segments.voiceover_text: Hakari is crying in Rentarou's arms. She cannot do this anymore, she whispers. And that is exactly when her mother appears. Hahari's apology is pure ice. This just became a family war.

Later, Hahari admits she has been worried for a long time. To her, this whole romance is not a show. Her daughter deserves a calm, ordinary place to belong. Every word is gentle. Every word is a verdict.
Hakari pushes back. It is not like that, she insists. But her voice is small, and the crack in this family is already showing.

parts.title: The Girls Refuse to Lose Her

series.summary: With Hakari pulled away, the other girlfriends gather at the mansion. The mood swings from uneasy comedy to desperation, a girl collapses in the hallway, and the group realizes winning Hakari back will take an actual operation.

segments.voiceover_text: With Hakari gone, the rest of the girlfriends crowd into the mansion lounge. Nobody is laughing. Rentarou's worry hangs over the whole room. They all like the same boy. Tonight that might be the only thing that saves him.
The jokes cannot survive this mood. One thought keeps surfacing, and it is not funny anymore. They cannot forget what Hahari said. This will take a real operation.
Then the night turns ugly. A girl lies collapsed on the hallway floor. A hand reaches out for her. Panic spreads fast. Whatever the mother planned, the cost is getting real.

series.summary: Rentarou rallies the girls and wins an audience with Hahari. The meeting turns tense fast, and inside the family altar room he discovers the portrait of Hakari's late father smiling down at him.

segments.voiceover_text: Rentarou stands before the girls and says it plainly. He will not let Hahari get away with any of this. Then the household gathers, excited to finally meet him. It feels like an honor. It is actually a trap.
The meeting with Hahari starts warm. She has a favor to ask, and that should scare anyone. Rentarou is led into the family altar room. Something on that altar is waiting for him.
A portrait. A smiling young man Rentarou has never seen. Hakari's voice answers before he can ask. That is her father. The whole room goes quiet.

parts.title: A Mother's Impossible Question About Love

series.summary: At the altar, Hahari asks why Rentarou faced her alone, then exposes the wound underneath: her first love died, and she has wondered ever since whether that love was real. Rentarou answers with a vow to believe and prove it.

segments.voiceover_text: Hahari studies the boy in front of her. Why did he come alone? She lets him speak, but her loneliness leaks out first. She has been waiting so long.

Then the real question lands. If there had been two of him, one love would be a lie. So which was real? Her voice shakes. Sixteen years of grief sit underneath it. This is the wound that started everything.
Rentarou does not flinch. He takes her shoulders and answers. All he can do is believe the love is real. All he can do is love. So be patient, he says, and let him prove it.

series.summary: Hahari breaks. In front of the altar she confesses her love, cries into Rentarou's chest and begs for a kiss, then panics over the all-important first kiss and bolts, already regretting everything.

segments.voiceover_text: It happens in front of the altar. Hahari says it out loud. She loves him. She falls into Rentarou's chest, tears soaking his shirt, and begs him for a kiss. But the first kiss matters most. Panic hijacks the whole moment. The final result is chaos.

She pulls herself together, kind of. Forget it, she laughs. Go back to everyone. Then she freezes. She is absolutely going to regret this. The scariest mother in this story just became its biggest disaster. Nobody saw this coming tonight.

parts.title: She Loves Him Too, Out Loud

series.summary: Back with the girls, exhaustion and relief hit at once. Hahari formally asks to join them for a day, then tells Rentarou she loves him too in front of everyone, and this time nobody stops the kiss.

segments.voiceover_text: Back with the others, the exhaustion hits all at once. Nothing feels real anymore. Someone is ready to sleep standing up. That is what fighting a mother all night does to a person.
Then Hahari asks for something nobody expected. A meeting. Just for today. She wants to stand in the same club as the girls she fought. The answer is yes. Of course it is yes.
And then she says it again, in front of everyone. Rentarou, she loves him too. There is so much she wants to say to her family. This time, nobody stops the kiss.

parts.title: The Father Who Watched Sixteen Years

series.summary: A white-haired figure appears in the dark hallway: the spirit of Hakari's father, who has watched over the family for sixteen years. He gives Rentarou his blessing, entrusts him with his children's future, and fades as Hahari renews the promise she once made him.

segments.voiceover_text: The hallway goes cold. A white-haired young man stands in the dark, smiling. The same face as the portrait. He has watched over this family for sixteen years. He is happy to finally see them smiling together. Rentarou stares, stunned silent. Hahari whispers one word. Father.

Then it is time to go. He leaves them the future of his precious children. Hahari answers the promise she once made him. She wanted this child. She would choose the same again. The ghost fades, and the blessing stays.

parts.title: He Is Still Waiting in the Dark

series.summary: The night ends with everyone heading home safely and a promise to meet again soon. After the show winks at the audience, one last shot reveals the father's spirit still standing in the dark hallway, waiting for Rentarou.

segments.voiceover_text: The long night finally lets go. Hahari tells everyone to get home safely and come back early. Rentarou promises. They will see each other soon. Then it hits her. This whole night belonged to the two of them.
And then the show itself breaks the wall. Nobody expected this anime either, it admits, inviting everyone to keep watching.
But one shadow never left. In the dark hallway, the white-haired father still stands there. Still smiling. He calls out to Rentarou. He is waiting for him.
